notes.title: Demo Update: Fast Forward, UI Improvements & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks so much for trying out the demo for MultiEnding Heroes.
Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and I've just pushed a new update to make your experience even better.

[b]What’s New in This Update?[/b]
[list]
[*] Fast Forward Button: You can now skip through dialogue at a higher speed! Perfect for scenes you've already seen.
[*] Stage Selection Screen Updates: 
You can see your total Money, EXP, and Endings Found.
The Skill Tree is now visible and accessible from here too!
[*] Fixed: A bug where certain scenes were unintentionally repeating.
[*] Minor visual bugs fixed.
[/list]
These improvements are all thanks to your support and feedback, so please keep it coming!

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
I'm continuing to fine-tune the game and work toward the full release. Your feedback during this demo phase is incredibly valuable.

If you enjoyed the demo, don’t forget to wishlist the game as it really helps! 

Thanks again,
NicoDiti
